name: com.nkstudio.savestore
description: Domain-partitioned, checkpoint-based save system on MemoryPack. Only dirty domains are serialized into pooled buffers at checkpoints and committed atomically (generational blobs + manifest, CRC, snapshot rollback) through a pluggable ISaveStorage (file, memory, WebGL). Includes save slots, payload transforms (Deflate, HMAC, AES+HMAC), clock injection, in-memory transactions, cloud sync hooks (commit events, snapshots), dynamic domains, a save viewer and golden-file test helpers.
